description: This file defines the Dispatcher class and related classes for managing test execution, worker processes, and test result reporting in a test runner framework, specifically for Playwright's test infrastructure.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Manages test execution, worker pool, and reporting for Playwright's test runner.

classes.name: JobDispatcher
classes.description: Handles individual test group execution, test lifecycle events, retries, and communication with workers.

methods.name: _findFirstJobToRun
methods.description: Finds the first test group in the queue that can be scheduled based on worker limits.

methods.name: _scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules the next test group to run if resources are available.

methods.name: _runJobInWorker
methods.description: Executes a test group in a specific worker, handling worker lifecycle and test execution.

methods.name: _checkFinished
methods.description: Checks if all tests and workers have completed, resolving the finish promise if so.

methods.name: _isWorkerRedundant
methods.description: Determines if a worker is redundant based on its hash and queued/running counts.

methods.name: _updateCounterForWorkerHash
methods.description: Updates the count of queued or running workers with a specific hash.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the test execution process with a list of test groups and environment variables.

methods.name: _createWorker
methods.description: Creates and initializes a WorkerHost instance for executing tests.

methods.name: producedEnvByProjectId
methods.description: Returns environment variables produced by workers, keyed by project ID.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all workers and halts test execution.
